description: Userinfo with its own segment capitalized
settles: That the connect endpoints match case the same way the well-known names do. A well-known name is often answered by something sitting in front of the application's own router, so CAP-044 could not speak for this family: asked separately, Userinfo reaches userinfo and earns the challenge CAP-019 records, rather than the 404 a case-sensitive router would give.
